advancement.lyycore.root.description:
It sparkles!
Obtain an imaginary crystal.

advancement.lyycore.production.title: Production and Building
advancement.lyycore.production.descripti: Choose machines to produce and collect the resources you need.
advancement.lyycore.rituals.title: Rituals and Crafting
advancement.lyycore.rituals.description: Summon the guardian and discover a new way to craft.
advancement.lyycore.materials.handmade_a:
Hand-crafted alloy, made with brute force.
Craft imaginary alloy at a crafting table.
advancement.lyycore.materials.alloy_forg:
Now that's efficient.

advancement.lyycore.production.gathering:
Crystals can appear out of thin air?

advancement.lyycore.production.collector:
Pick up everything on the ground, too.

You can generate power like this?

advancement.lyycore.production.miniature:

message.lyycore.foreign_research: This knowledge does not belong to you
message.lyycore.foreign_production: This research product does not belong to you
message.lyycore.ender_sentry.unknown: What is this? You know nothing about it.
message.lyycore.ender_sentry.recalled: Your ender dragon has been recalled.
message.lyycore.ender_sentry.blocked: There is not enough space near the sentry.
message.lyycore.ender_sentry.summoned: Your ender dragon has been summoned. Age: %s days.
message.lyycore.ender_sentry.day: Set your ender dragon's age to %s days.
research.lyycore.advanced_imaginary_gate: This gate should be capable of far more. The foe we defeated seems to have been only its guardian, yet we cannot pass through. What kind of technology is this? The gate radiates tremendous power. Could we put it to use? We will need to experiment… First, let us build a laboratory.
research.lyycore.ender_sentry.title: Ender Sentry
research.lyycore.ender_sentry.summary: Surely this egg is more than a decoration.
research.lyycore.ender_sentry.descriptio: I have always wondered whether the dragon egg could serve a purpose. Tales from other worlds speak of dragons becoming mounts, but that seems beyond me. Perhaps infusing the egg with our own mysterious power could achieve something…
tooltip.lyycore.imaginary_reaper.chain: Chain lightning hits up to 5 targets; each link retains 90% damage
tooltip.lyycore.imaginary_reaper.control: Right-click: mining mode; Shift + right-click: settings
tooltip.lyycore.storm_ball: Throw in the Overworld for 1 hour of thunderstorms; craft into a Sun Ball
tooltip.lyycore.sun_ball: Throw in the Overworld for 1 hour of clear skies; craft into a Storm Ball
message.lyycore.weather_ball.overworld_o: Weather balls can only be used in the Overworld.
research.lyycore.imaginary_reaper.title: What Is This? Give It a Whack.
research.lyycore.imaginary_reaper.summar: I am just an ordinary scientist. I do not have their kind of power.
research.lyycore.imaginary_reaper.descri: Our tool is convenient for mining, but its speed leaves much to be desired, and we still have to flee from monsters. It is time for an upgrade... First, I need to collect some lightning.
research.lyycore.change_weather.title: Change the Weather
research.lyycore.change_weather.summary: This looks familiar. Let me take another look.
research.lyycore.change_weather.descript: We need the power to control the weather. It never rains when we need rain, and it always pours when we want clear skies.
tooltip.lyycore.description.lightning_bo: Right-click a glass bottle during a thunderstorm to collect; summons a lightning strike
research.lyycore.why_cant_people_fly.sum: People must learn to fly. But not just yet.
research.lyycore.why_cant_people_fly.des:
Time for a little biotechnology.

Gain wings that halve non-void damage and let you glide as if wearing an elytra. When struck, the wings form a shield. Toggle their appearance here in Memory; hiding them keeps their effects.
research.lyycore.welcome_the_challenge.d:
We didn't come here just to challenge the gatekeeper. Let us witness the true strength of creatures from another world.

Transcribe the report and process it in the Laboratory for 10 seconds to make a Small Imaginary Core. Offer it to an Advanced Imaginary Gate to summon Life Revels On. Defeat it within 180 seconds to obtain the Heart of Nothingness.
message.lyycore.coordinates.limit: Power target limit reached (%s); cannot bind another target
tooltip.lyycore.coordinates.use: Record a block, then use on a tower to bind/remove the target machine; sneak-use to record again
tooltip.lyycore.coordinates.limit: Tower: up to 20 targets; matrix: up to 30. Use a bound device again to remove that target.
advancement.lyycore.well_fed.title: Well Fed
research.lyycore.adaptive_enhancement.su: At last, we have reached this point...
research.lyycore.adaptive_enhancement.de:
The battle confirmed that our exploration of this energy has only just begun. The inorganic creatures it affects seem to have a civilization of their own. Will we one day find someone we can talk to? For now, we do not know. Our last experiment showed that our bodies adapt well to this energy. Perhaps we can use it to greatly strengthen ourselves. We cannot miss this opportunity.

Process the report in a laboratory for 300 seconds to produce a Supermutation Factor. Drink it to unlock skills and styles.
research.lyycore.exploration.title: Exploration
research.lyycore.exploration.description:
Nothing seems to have changed. Did it fail? Let us explore what our bodies can do.

Unlocks basic skills for all four styles; drink a Supermutation Factor to enable the skill system.
Building: creative flight; each hit adds void damage equal to one quarter of maximum health.
Mobility: dash 4 blocks using the special key and movement direction.
Technique: hold the special key to guard. Hits within the first 4 ticks are perfectly guarded and add 10 guard points; normal guards cost 4 and reduce damage by 50%. If you are sneaking and holding forward when you press the special key, blocking an enemy hit within the first 4 ticks automatically counters for current guard points ×0.4 +40 damage. Otherwise, when that window ends, counter a hostile within 10 blocks for guard points ×0.4 damage. You must still be sneaking when either counter triggers. Forward may already be held; no second press after blocking is needed. Each special-key press counters only once and consumes all guard points; no target means no consumption.
Offense: damage triggers four additional physical feather strikes of 10 damage each.
advancement.lyycore.better.title: Better!
advancement.lyycore.better.description: Obtain an Imaginary Condensing Beacon to unlock Adaptive Enhancement and Exploration research.
message.lyycore.beacon_owned: This beacon is bound to another player
tooltip.lyycore.incomplete_potion: Something seems off. Try pouring it back in.
research.lyycore.hot_pot.title: Hot Pot?!
research.lyycore.hot_pot.description: Let us try a more hands-on experiment. Tossing these things together could be fun…
research.lyycore.wings_enhancement.title: Enhancement
research.lyycore.wings_enhancement.descr: Why stop at flying? These wings deserve another experiment. A Heart of Nothingness, two phantom membranes, and a dragon egg. Perfect.
research.lyycore.mind_control.title: You Are Under My Control
research.lyycore.mind_control.summary: How to make monsters less troublesome.
research.lyycore.mind_control.descriptio: Our enemies can command lesser monsters. Could their hearts let us do the same? Combine several for more power. Perhaps slime and lava will hold them together…
jei.lyycore.cauldron.instructions: Add ingredients, then use a glass bottle. One bottle consumes the entire mixture. Extra ingredients are allowed.
tooltip.lyycore.description.mind_control: Powerful enough that only one can be active at a time.
research.lyycore.go_blades.title: Go, Blades!
research.lyycore.go_blades.summary: My wings are as sharp as ever.
research.lyycore.go_blades.description:
Show our enemies what these wings can do.

Unlocks Rising Sweep in Offense style: while sneaking and holding Forward, press the special skill key. Follow the player and strike damageable living entities along the flying feathers’ paths once for 40 physical damage, launching them upward. The action lasts 2 seconds and cannot be repeated before it finishes.
research.lyycore.behind_you.title: Look Behind You
research.lyycore.behind_you.summary: Become even harder to pin down.
research.lyycore.behind_you.description: Unlocks Blink in Mobility style: while sneaking and holding Forward, press the special skill key to teleport one block behind the nearest enemy within a 10×10×10 area. Applies Slowness 255 for 1 second and suspends you in the air for 1 second. Cooldown: 1 second. Excludes players and neutral creatures; includes phantoms. Blocked destinations cancel the skill.
entity.lyycore.guiding_light: The Light That Leads the Way
research.lyycore.any_more.title: Is There More?
research.lyycore.any_more.description:
Perhaps we should challenge a stronger opponent. Are we ready? First, prepare a guiding reagent from a slimeball, magma cream, spider eye, rotten flesh, the heart of our former foe, a dragon egg, a nether star and a crystal block.

Process the research report in the Laboratory for 30 seconds to obtain Proof. Offer it at the Advanced Imaginary Gate to summon The Light That Leads the Way.
tooltip.lyycore.description.pure_smeltin: Endless power will ignite the core.
Supply items and energy at the bottom front. Sneak-use to adjust speed.
tooltip.lyycore.description.imaginary_dr: Produces a dragon egg every five minutes. Sneak-use to change dragon mode.
message.lyycore.ender_sentry.evolved: Your dragon has evolved. Manage it through its nest.
jei.lyycore.pure_smelting.activation: Insert Unextinguished Desire into the shell to activate it. Inputs are unordered. Sneak-use for 1–100× speed; power scales with the square of speed.
advancement.lyycore.too_great.title: Wonderful!...?
advancement.lyycore.closed_gate.title: What Happened?
advancement.lyycore.closed_gate.descript: The door to a new world is closed...
research.lyycore.what_now.title: What Now?
research.lyycore.what_now.description: This was unexpected. Have we angered their civilization, or begun a trial? We cannot stop here. Let us continue our research; a closed door will not end our journey.
research.lyycore.high_purity.title: High Purity
research.lyycore.high_purity.description: We nearly forgot this. It must be the cause of the change. I can feel its immense energy and its close connection to that world. We cannot obtain more for now, so we must decide carefully how to use it.
research.lyycore.giant_dragon.title: Great Dragon
research.lyycore.giant_dragon.descriptio: Our little dragon stopped changing after reaching a certain age. Perhaps our child needs a little more care...
research.lyycore.sacrifice.title: Sacrifice
research.lyycore.sacrifice.description: Perhaps our forceful summons angered them. Could an altar be a better way? Warning: this may attract an unexpected calamity.
research.lyycore.more_and_more.title: More and More
research.lyycore.more_and_more.descripti: Our power generation is falling behind again. We need a more powerful generator.
research.lyycore.double_jump.title: Double Jump
research.lyycore.double_jump.description: Gather energy beneath your feet to jump once more while airborne. A passive ability exclusive to Mobility style.
research.lyycore.speed_up.title: Speed Up!
research.lyycore.speed_up.description: Double the thrust of wing-assisted elytra flight, without a speed limit.
research.lyycore.fission.title: Fission
research.lyycore.fission.description: It is time to improve the furnace... perhaps a little too much.
tooltip.lyycore.summoning_altar: Do not place in the dark...
message.lyycore.altar.layout: Place eight offering stands at the corners and edge centers of a 5×5 square, at the same height.
message.lyycore.altar.occupied: A summoned boss is already present.
message.lyycore.altar.blocked: Not enough room at the summoning location.
gui.lyycore.dragon.unavailable: The bound nest cannot be found. Mode controls are unavailable.
message.lyycore.altar.life_materials: Offer 4 Imaginary Steel Blocks and 4 Crystal Blocks, one on each outer offering stand.
research.lyycore.in_our_hands.title: In Our Hands
research.lyycore.in_our_hands.summary: More than soaring through the sky.
research.lyycore.in_our_hands.descriptio:
Our companion is willing to become our strength. Charge for up to 1 second: each laser deals (1+t)^4 x 40 magic damage, up to 640, with a 64-block range. Offense fires four lasers; Technique adds 50% damage reduction while drawing. With the dragon stowed, hits apply a 5-second burn, stacking up to three levels for 50/100/400 magic damage per second. Otherwise, damage is quartered and the burn is disabled. Sneak-use opens the remote dragon controls.
Without a queryable bound nest: lasers deal ten times base damage (6400 at full charge), without dragonfire.
research.lyycore.blazing_pursuit.title: Blazing Pursuit
research.lyycore.blazing_pursuit.descrip: Our wings can cut through the sky and burn our enemies. Replaces Offense's feather follow-up with one 640-point fire hit, retaining the one-second internal cooldown.
research.lyycore.ritual.title: Ritual
research.lyycore.ritual.description: Explore what else the altar can summon. Brew Unextinguished Desire in the alloy cauldron for Amplification Potion. Any wool color is accepted for research. Place a Token of Friendship on the central ritual altar, and four Imaginary Steel Blocks plus four Crystal Blocks on the eight outer offering stands. Sneak-use to begin a three-phase battle in a 25 x 15 x 25 arena. Curse of Life stacks every 45 seconds. More deaths than the initial participant count ends the encounter. Victory grants Endless Erosion and 3000 XP. If any present player's maximum health is at most 8 before curses are cleared, also receive the Sonnet bow.
tooltip.lyycore.description.amplificatio: Brew Unextinguished Desire in an alloy cauldron. Used for Ritual research.
tooltip.lyycore.description.endless_eros: A material dropped by the Usurper Who Corrodes Life.
tooltip.lyycore.description.friendly_pro: Offer at the ritual altar, with 4 Imaginary Steel Blocks and 4 Crystal Blocks on the outer offering stands. Sneak-use to begin.
research.lyycore.immersion.title: Immersion
research.lyycore.immersion.description: Erosion can do more than fight. Let it transform our blocks.
research.lyycore.self.title: Self
research.lyycore.self.description: We have come a long way. It is time to collect our thoughts again.
research.lyycore.energy_conservation.des: Replace our many factories with a simpler way to produce and retrieve resources.
research.lyycore.specialization.title: Specialization
research.lyycore.specialization.descript: Let this power enter reality in forms we recognize.
gui.lyycore.erosion.template_hint: Template is retained. Match stone/cobblestone or deepslate/cobbled deepslate to the ore host.
gui.lyycore.otherworld.take: Click for one; Shift-click for a stack.
gui.lyycore.otherworld.cost: 10,000 IE each; redstone enables left/right output.

research.lyycore.in_depth_research.title: In-depth Research
research.lyycore.in_depth_research.descr: Research does not always go smoothly.
research.lyycore.hail.title: Hail
research.lyycore.hail.description: Let us see what we can do with it.
jei.lyycore.experiment_table: Complete In-depth Research and process its report in a Laboratory for 60 seconds. Ice, packed ice and blue ice supply 1, 9 and 81 ice points; magma supplies 1 fire point; a lightning bottle supplies 4 lightning points. Each reserve holds 100. Match the current graph to the pale target. Moving or swapping costs one point of the first selected node's element. Reset restores the initial layout without spending or refunding points. Finish the report here before processing it in a Laboratory.
jei.lyycore.hail: Complete Hail research, transcribe its report, finish its experiment, then process it in a Laboratory for 5 seconds. Right-click: immediately deal 20 independent ice hits to enemies within 10 blocks, each with 20 base damage; freeze water within 4 blocks underfoot. Cooldown: 1 second. Mobility style also dashes forward 5 blocks, leaving an ice flower. After 1 second it immediately deals 16 independent ice hits to all living entities except the user within 3 blocks, each with 10 base damage.
